recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7424; future maintenance or reintroduction of ClinicalAssessment should preserve the assessment-process/instrument distinction without reintroducing the obsolete ClinicalImpression-versus-ClinicalAssessment rationale.
issue_request: Published / Not Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue for DSTU1 ClinicalImpression. It asked to use ClinicalAssessment rather than ClinicalImpression; the final resolution kept ClinicalImpression but required Scope and Usage text clarifying that an impression is a clinical summation and/or opinion formed as the outcome of the clinical assessment process, may lead to a Condition, and that in FHIR an assessment is typically an instrument or tool used to collect patient information.
initial_application: Commit ca8df34006df02f9b2a896eaf41a72e1d418fe9d explicitly listed #7424 and added the two requested Scope and Usage paragraphs to source/clinicalimpression/clinicalimpression-introduction.xml. The retained ClinicalImpression introduction still contains the clarification.
additional_context: FHIR-11290 and FHIR-18859 were later withdrawn or no-change ClinicalImpression naming discussions. FHIR-46596 later superseded the no-rename portion for R6 by renaming ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, and that reconciliation is already on the combined branch. FHIR-50192 removed the invalid post-rename ClinicalAssessment-rather-than-ClinicalAssessment rationale from the successor StructureDefinition. Commit fad1b9cf84 removed ClinicalAssessment from active source/fhir.ini resource entries and active narrative now links ClinicalAssessment to the PC incubator.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The historical FHIR-7424 clarification is already present in retained source, the successor ClinicalAssessment source no longer has the old name-rationale sentence, and current active core build scope contains neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment as a core resource page.
